text:
Jamie (Support): ping — Acme reported a hard 400 on a function/tool invoke. They say schema validation fails and things that should be nullable are blowing up. Customer repro + error below.
Nguyen (Eng-ML): can you paste the exact request body and the error payload from our API?
Jamie (Support): pasted below (redacted customer ids). they used the tool `user-data-lookup` via function call.
```json
{
  "user_id": "acct_42",
  "session": null,
  "metadata": null,
  "billingProfile": {
    "plan": "pro",
    "interval": "monthly"
  },
  "retries": 1
}
```
Jamie (Support): API response:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Function invocation failed: request body did not match function schema",
    "details": [
      {"path": "/metadata", "error": "type", "expected": "object", "got": "null"},
      {"path": "/session", "error": "required", "message": "session is required when metadata is null"},
      {"path": "/billingProfile/externalId", "error": "additionalProperties", "message": "unexpected key 'externalId'"}
    ]
  }
}
```
Tereza (Eng-Runtime): interesting — schema shows `session` as required unless `metadata` is present. But our schema is `metadata: { type: object }` (no `nullable: true`). If the runtime coerces `null` -> absent, the required rule is triggered.
Nguyen (Eng-ML): can you also paste the function's declared schema snippet?
Jamie (Support): snippet from registry:
```json
{
  "name": "user-data-lookup",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "user_id": { "type": "string" },
      "session": { "type": "string" },
      "metadata": { "type": "object", "properties": { "source": { "type": "string" } } },
      "billingProfile": { "type": "object", "properties": { "plan": { "type": "string" }, "interval": { "type": "string" } }, "additionalProperties": false }
    },
    "required": ["user_id"],
    "additionalProperties": false
  }
}
```
Nguyen (Eng-ML): OK — two issues: (1) `metadata` isn't declared `nullable`, so a literal `null` fails type check; (2) customer added `billingProfile.externalId` (we currently forbid additional props). The error about `session required when metadata is null` looks like business logic living in our validator layer (post-schema).
Mike (Oncall): can we reproduce quickly? Jamie, what's the curl they used?
Jamie (Support):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-acme' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tool":"user-data-lookup","input": {"user_id":"acct_42","session":null,"metadata":null,"billingProfile":{"plan":"pro","interval":"monthly","externalId":"ext-9"},"retries":1}}'
```
Mike (Oncall): repro'ed locally — validator rejects at JSON Schema stage with clear messages. Two quick mitigation paths: (A) short term: allow `nullable: true` for `metadata` in the function registry (backfill) and accept additional properties for billingProfile OR (B) customer-facing: surface clearer 400 with actionable guidance and a sample payload.
Tereza (Eng-Runtime): long term: we should make runtime coerce `null` -> absent only for optional fields when schema says `nullable: true`. Right now the coercion is too aggressive and causes required/conditional logic to misfire. I'll open a runtime bug.
Nguyen (Eng-ML): also suggest adding a schema lint rule in onboarding to flag `additionalProperties: false` when customers may pass external ids.
Jamie (Support): Customer asked for timeline; they want a hotfix. Can someone own the short-term registry change?
Tereza (Eng-Runtime): I can push a micro-patch to the registry to mark `metadata` as `nullable` and temporarily relax `billingProfile` to allow `externalId` (set `additionalProperties: true`). Will do and post PR link.
Nguyen (Eng-ML): once PR is up, can we add a regression test for the case where `metadata` is null and `session` absent?
Tereza (Eng-Runtime): yes, will include.
deploy-bot: deploy started for commit a1b2c3 (registry: function user-data-lookup) :rocket:
Tereza (Eng-Runtime): done — patch deployed to staging. Jamie, can you ask Acme to try again against staging or we can roll to prod after validation.
Jamie (Support): pinged customer with staging URL and instructions. They replied they can test in 10m.
Mike (Oncall): leaving note: track as P1 for customer-impacting function validation; add to incident board if they request prod rollback.
Jamie (Support): thanks all. Will update thread with customer verification and follow-up notes. :thumbsup:
